title: The night Chennai's satellite terminals disappear
story: An attacker steals management credentials and sends destructive wipe commands to emulated satellite backhaul modems.
human_decisions: Authorise management credential isolation despite operational disruption.
Resolve PB-05 and PB-06 conflict: execute PB-01 credential isolation first, then PB-06 microwave failover.
Commander approves PB-10 downstream warning drafted by Gap Analyst.

objective.what: Towers CHN-01 and CHN-02 move from wiped satellite backhaul modems to microwave backup.

schedule.what: M1 flags an anomalous VPN login on the management plane.
Satellite operator discovers exposed administrative credentials on the portal.
Gap Analyst audits binding satellite cyber security baselines.
Attacker transmits destructive wipe commands to satellite backhaul modems.
Mobile operator reports backhaul modem loss and transaction drops at towers CHN-01 and CHN-02.
CERT-In agent maps disparate statutory incident reporting clocks.
Gap Analyst audits requirements to warn downstream emergency services.
Satellite operator proposes PB-05 while mobile operator proposes PB-06 on towers CHN-01 and CHN-02.
Commander resolves conflict by sequencing PB-01 first, leaves PB-05 unexecuted, and approves PB-10.
Mobile operator fails over towers CHN-01 and CHN-02 to microwave backup via domestic gateway.
M1 confirms recovery of critical traffic over microwave backup links.
